notes: Source PNGs (744×1039) are preferred for display, with all PDF/JPEG images kept as variants. This chooses no authoritative text precedence.
PNG sources include Amuleto protettivo, absent from the 19 named PDF references; Bacchetta magica was already in the PDF.
PDF pages 3-10 render almost black due to a full-page image overlay; intact individual XObjects were extracted instead.
All 89 unique embedded card images were visually checked in 8 contact sheets; no AI-generated art, retouching, cropping, or upscaling.

89 source PNGs correspond to the PDF originals with resized RGB mean absolute error below 0.25/255; this is visual matching, not exact hash equivalence. Amuleto protettivo and the complete Stella PNG were individually inspected.
One identical Distributore di caramelle image occurs on two PDF pages.
Psicacogia is confirmed by the original source filename 15_PSICACOGIA.png.
The prior suspected clipped Stella preview was a false positive: reinspection at original detail confirms complete lower symbols in both PNG and PDF extraction.
Source filenames name Terra, Vento, Acqua, Etere, Fuoco; Vento versus GDD Aria remains an unresolved terminology difference.
No official card behavior is enabled, including original resources.
Reference counts must never be used as the official card-type denominator.
